description: LADOT Parking Meter Occupancy is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Last known occupancy state of those City of Los Angeles Parking Meters equipped with occupancy detector sensors. Updated in real-time, as available. See "LADOT Metered Parking Inventory & Policies" dataset for location and parking policy details. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are express park, parking, occupancy, meter, availability. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: LADOT Parking Meters Division - LA ExpressPark. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
